reasons.message: UF requires a 2.6 critical-tracking GPA for this milestone; that threshold is only in the text, so it isn't checked.

reasons.message: UF requires a 2.75 critical-tracking GPA for this milestone; it isn't checked.
"The final tracking course" means all four by semester 5; the data stores it as any one of the four, so the cumulative count isn't checked.
